# Bauhaus Theme

[GitHub Download Link](https://github.com/EvobyteDigitalBiology/st-styled/blob/main/src/st_yled/themes/bauhaus/config.toml)

![Bauhaus Theme Preview Placeholder](https://evo-byte.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/bauhaus_light.png)

Bauhaus is a bold, editorial style with strong contrast and geometric character.

## Highlights

- Strong accent primary color for calls to action
- Structured typography for headings and body text
- Light and dark variants included
